description: Compaction hooks create a deduplicated checkpoint skeleton and, where supported, re-inject the engine-owned PM snapshot without blocking compaction.

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then py=python3; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then py=python; else py=; fi; if [ -n "$py" ]; then "$py" .project_manager/tools/pm_log.py checkpoint --trigger compaction --phase pre --cwd "$PWD" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"[ctx-checkpoint] compaction 이 일어난다. checkpoint 골격이 생성됐다면 구간·서사 불릿을 즉시 채워라. 골격이 없으면 python3 .project_manager/tools/pm_log.py checkpoint --task <이름> --trigger compaction 으로 수동 기록하라. compaction은 차단되지 않는다.","suppressOutput":false}'
hooks.commandWindows: $py = $null; if (Get-Command python3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $py = 'python3' } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $py = 'python' }; if ($null -ne $py) { & $py '.project_manager/tools/pm_log.py' checkpoint --trigger compaction --phase pre --cwd $PWD.Path *> $null }; Write-Output '{"systemMessage":"[ctx-checkpoint] Compaction is starting. If a checkpoint skeleton was created, immediately fill its interval and narrative bullets. If none exists, manually run python3 .project_manager/tools/pm_log.py checkpoint --task <name> --trigger compaction. Compaction is not blocked.","suppressOutput":false}'

hooks.commandWindows: $py = $null; if (Get-Command python3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $py = 'python3' } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $py = 'python' }; if ($null -ne $py) { & $py '.project_manager/tools/pm_log.py' checkpoint --trigger compaction --phase pre --cwd $PWD.Path *> $null }; Write-Output '{"systemMessage":"[ctx-checkpoint] Compaction is starting. If a checkpoint skeleton was created, immediately fill its interval and narrative bullets. If none exists, manually run python3 .project_manager/tools/pm_log.py checkpoint --task <name> --trigger compaction. Compaction is not blocked.","suppressOutput":false}'

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then py=python3; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then py=python; else py=; fi; if [ -z "$py" ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"suppressOutput":true}'; else "$py" .project_manager/tools/pm_log.py checkpoint --trigger compaction --phase post --cwd "$PWD" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; "$py" .project_manager/tools/pm_log.py snapshot --cwd "$PWD" --json 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\n' '{"suppressOutput":true}'; fi
hooks.commandWindows: $py = $null; if (Get-Command python3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $py = 'python3' } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $py = 'python' }; if ($null -eq $py) { Write-Output '{"suppressOutput":true}' } else { & $py '.project_manager/tools/pm_log.py' checkpoint --trigger compaction --phase post --cwd $PWD.Path *> $null; & $py '.project_manager/tools/pm_log.py' snapshot --cwd $PWD.Path --json 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output '{"suppressOutput":true}' } }

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then py=python3; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then py=python; else py=; fi; if [ -z "$py" ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"suppressOutput":true}'; else "$py" .project_manager/tools/pm_log.py checkpoint --trigger compaction --phase post --cwd "$PWD" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; "$py" .project_manager/tools/pm_log.py snapshot --cwd "$PWD" --json 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\n' '{"suppressOutput":true}'; fi
hooks.commandWindows: $py = $null; if (Get-Command python3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $py = 'python3' } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $py = 'python' }; if ($null -eq $py) { Write-Output '{"suppressOutput":true}' } else { & $py '.project_manager/tools/pm_log.py' checkpoint --trigger compaction --phase post --cwd $PWD.Path *> $null; & $py '.project_manager/tools/pm_log.py' snapshot --cwd $PWD.Path --json 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output '{"suppressOutput":true}' } }
